ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white pixels (approx. 85%) with low-intensity black pixel distributions concentrated on the perimeter and central axis (approx. 15%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white blobs covering the majority of the left and right lobes. Black pigment mapping forms a continuous band along the trailing edge and a vertical bifurcating streak along the median notch. Scattered low-intensity focal spots are present in the lower interior quadrants of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 115 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile. The right lobe trailing edge exhibits significant high-amplitude peaks and valleys (ragged profile), while the left lobe shows lower-amplitude, more regular serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Leading edges exhibit a convex sweep terminating in slightly hooked, upward-turned tips; trailing edges show a generally concave curve from notch to tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-intensity white pixels (rosettes) are visible at the distal tips of both lobes, indicative of barnacle attachment sites or calcified scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (scratches) are visible: several diagonal marks on the lower left lobe and horizontal streaks near the lower-right fluke-to-peduncle junction.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The right lobe trailing edge exhibits extreme irregular topography and tissue loss, suggesting significant acquired physical trauma or amputation of edge segments.
other_distinctive_markers: Notable asymmetry between the relatively intact left lobe trailing edge and the heavily damaged/jagged right lobe trailing edge.
